title: Tractors and Machinery for Agriculture and Forestry - Noise Measurement - Method of Test, Part 2: Noise Emitted When in Motion
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12180 (PART 2)) covers Tractors and Machinery for Agriculture and Forestry - Noise Measurement - Method of Test, Part 2: Noise Emitted When in Motion. This Indian Standard (Part 2) which is identical with ISO 7216 : 1992 'Acoustics — Agricultural and forestry wheeled tracters and self-propelled machines — Measurement of noise emitted when in motion' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Sectional Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. This standard was first published in 1987 and based on ISO 5131 : 1982 and DIS 7216. With the revision of ISO 5131 in 1996 it has been decided to revise this standard also. This standard will be published in two parts. This part (Part 2) covers measurement of noise when tractor in motion and Part 1 covers method of measurement at operator's ear level. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is drawn specially to the following: a) Wherever the words International Standard* appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as Indian Standard
clause_3_terminology: Tractors and Machinery for Agriculture and Forestry
Part 2: Noise Emitted When in Motion

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
